title: 第三十七章 母体-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一

    顾衍回来的第二天，苏棠做了一桌甜品宴。

    松饼、桂花糕、灵蜜派、奶茶、灵果布丁——不是菜，是甜品的升级版。白芷看着满桌子甜品，眼睛瞪圆了：师姐，你什么时候会做这么多品种了？

    苏棠端上最后一盘布丁，解下围裙：上辈子就会。只是没时间做。

    她在顾衍对面坐下，给他盛了一碗奶茶：喝。补身体。

    顾衍低头喝着奶茶，没说话。喝完一碗，他自己又盛了一碗。苏棠注意到他盛奶茶的手很稳——比昨天稳多了。

    好喝。顾衍说。

    白芷在旁边小声补了一句：师姐，你以后能不能每天做甜品？我不想再吃自己煮的糊粥了。

    苏棠弹了一下她的额头：你多练练就不糊了。明天开始，我教你。

    白芷眼睛亮了。胖橘蹲在桌边，面前放着一条清蒸灵鱼，吃得头都不抬。小青龙盘在奶茶碗旁边，偷喝了一口，被烫得缩回了头。小雪从剑里飘出来，坐在桌沿上，小手捧着一朵桂花闻——她不吃，但喜欢那个味道。沈夜白坐在苏棠旁边，安静地吃布丁，每样都尝一遍，吃得不多，但每一口都嚼得很认真。

    云隐和云逸也在。云隐吃了一口松饼，眼睛亮了一下：苏棠，你这手艺，可以开酒楼了。云逸在旁边点头，嘴里塞满了灵蜜派，说不出话。晚棠坐在云隐旁边，喝了一口奶茶，深红色的眼睛里有一丝柔软。殷无邪站在晚棠身后，端着一碗饭，吃得比谁都香。

    一张桌子，挤了十一个——九个修士，两只妖，一个剑灵。小雪不算人也不算妖，但她占了一个位置。

    苏棠看着满屋子的人，没说话。她想起极北之地的冰原，想起冰洞里的碎片，想起母体中那团扭动的光雾。这些人在这里吃松饼，不知道外面的世界正在发生什么。她不想告诉他们。她只想让他们继续吃松饼。

    二

    吃完饭，苏棠把顾衍叫到了二楼客厅。

    沈夜白跟在后面，手里拿着玉片——晚棠给的母体地图。小雪飘在苏棠肩膀上，小手抓着她的衣领。胖橘蹲在桌上，小青龙盘在茶壶旁边。

    苏棠从包袱里拿出那个布包，放在桌上。布包里有十二块碎片，暗红色的光芒透过布层透出来，在桌面上投下一片暗淡的红晕。她打开布包，碎片一颗一颗滚出来，在桌面上排成一排。

    顾衍，你在冰洞里的时候，有没有感觉到碎片在'召唤'什么？

    顾衍沉默了。灰色眼睛盯着那些碎片，手指在桌面上轻轻敲着：有。不只是召唤。它们在说话。不是用声音，是用意念。

    他抬起头看着苏棠：它们说'来'。

    苏棠握紧了茶杯。

    碎片说来。不是来我这里，是来我这里。碎片有意识——不，是碎片中的能量漩涡有一个核心，核心在召唤碎片聚集，在召唤能量来源。

    小棠，碎片的核心是什么？

    碎片中的能量漩涡有一个源头——母体。母体是所有碎片的源头，它产生的能量波动会影响所有碎片。如果母体活跃，所有碎片都会被激活，同时坠落。届时不是几十块，是成百上千块同时坠落。凡间的城镇会在一夜之间消失。

    苏棠的手指在茶杯边缘捏得发白。

    成百上千块碎片同时坠落。她想起清溪镇那个在碎片正下方的孩子，想起林晚棠用身体挡住碎片救下的三千人。她不想让那种事再发生。

    小棠，能提前清除母体吗？

    可以。但需要宿主找到母体，用锚点力量压制它的活性。目前已知的母体只有一个，位置在天外天最深处。宿主需要亲自去。

    苏棠站起来，在客厅里踱步。母体在天外天最深处。最深处是哪里？她去过归墟，去过蓝色山脉，去过生命灵泉。那些地方都不是最深处。最深处在生命灵泉的更北方，她锚点根须延伸不到的未知区域。

    晚棠也许知道。苏棠转身，天机阁的典籍比我们想象的丰富。

    三

    苏棠去找晚棠的时候，晚棠正在天机阁的书房里整理卷宗。

    殷无邪站在她身后，手里端着一碗参汤。这次晚棠没有喝，放在桌上凉着。深红色的长发披散在肩上，眉心有一道浅浅的皱纹——是思考留下的，不是烦恼。

    晚棠，我需要查天机阁所有关于'母体'的记载。苏棠没有绕弯子。

    晚棠放下手中的卷宗，看着苏棠。深红色眼睛里没惊讶，只有一种终于来了的平静：母体。我奶奶提过这个词。她说有一天你会来问。

    她从抽屉里拿出一个木盒。木盒比之前的任何一个都大，半臂长，一拃宽。盒盖上的纹饰不是天机阁的云纹，是一种苏棠从未见过的图案——一圈同心圆，圆心有一个点，像靶心，又像漩涡。

    这是林晚棠——我奶奶——留给我的。封印条件是'锚点询问母体'，刚才你说话时，封印自动解开了。

    晚棠把木盒推到苏棠面前：里面有三样东西：一张地图，一枚钥匙，一句话。

    苏棠打开木盒。

    一张地图。不是纸质的，是一块玉片，很薄，透光，边缘有磨损，像被人摩挲过很多次。玉片上刻着密密麻麻的线条。苏棠把玉片举起来，对着光看——线条在光线下变得立体，像一幅浮雕。是天外天的地图，比她见过的任何一张都详细。归墟、蓝色山脉、生命灵泉、灵泉以北的冰原、冰原以北的——一片空白。空白的边缘有一个红点，红点旁边写着两个小字：母体。
    第(1/3)页

1

The day after Gu Yan came back, Su Tang made a dessert banquet.

​​Waffles, osmanthus cake, Lingmi pie, milk tea, Lingguo pudding - they are not dishes, but upgraded versions of desserts.Bai Zhi looked at the table full of desserts, her eyes widened: Senior sister, when did you know how to make so many varieties?

Su Tang served the last plate of pudding and took off his apron: I knew how to do it in my previous life.Just don’t have time to do it.

She sat down opposite Gu Yan and served him a bowl of milk tea: drink.Replenish the body.

Gu Yan lowered his head and drank milk tea without saying anything.After finishing one bowl, he filled another bowl for himself.Su Tang noticed that his hand holding the milk tea was very steady - much more steady than yesterday.

Delicious.Gu Yan said.

Bai Zhi added in a low voice beside her: Senior sister, can you make desserts every day in the future?I don't want to eat the porridge I cooked anymore.

Su Tang flicked her forehead: The more you practice, the more blurry you will be.Starting tomorrow, I will teach you.

Bai Zhi’s eyes lit up.Fat Orange squatted at the table with a steamed spiritual fish in front of him, eating without even raising his head.The little green dragon was placed next to the milk tea bowl. He secretly took a sip and retracted his head due to the burn.Xiaoxue floated out of the sword and sat on the edge of the table, holding an osmanthus flower in her little hand and smelling it - she didn't eat it, but she liked the smell.Shen Yebai sat next to Su Tang and ate pudding quietly. He tasted everything, not much, but chewed every bite carefully.

Yunyin and Yun Yi are also there.Yunyin took a bite of the muffin and his eyes lit up: Su Tang, with your skills, you can open a restaurant.Yun Yi nodded beside him, his mouth full of Lingmi Pie and speechless.Wan Tang sat next to Yunyin and took a sip of milk tea. There was a hint of softness in her crimson eyes.Yin Wuxie stood behind Wan Tang, holding a bowl of rice and eating it more deliciously than anyone else.

There were eleven people crowded into one table - nine monks, two demons, and a sword spirit.Xiaoxue is neither a human nor a demon, but she occupies a position.

Su Tang looked at the room full of people and said nothing.She thought of the ice fields in the far north, the fragments in the ice caves, and the writhing mist of light in the mother body.These people are here eating muffins and have no idea what's going on in the outside world.She didn't want to tell them.She just wanted them to keep eating muffins.

2

After eating, Su Tang called Gu Yan to the living room on the second floor.

Shen Yebai followed behind, holding a jade piece in his hand - the map of the mother body given by Wan Tang.Light snow floated on Su Tang's shoulders, and his little hands grasped her collar.Fat Orange squatted on the table, and the little green dragon sat next to the teapot.

Su Tang took out the cloth bag from the baggage and placed it on the table.There were twelve fragments in the cloth bag, and the dark red light shone through the cloth layer, casting a dim red glow on the table.She opened the cloth bag and the fragments rolled out one by one and lined up on the table.

"Gu Yan, when you were in the ice cave, did you feel that the fragments were 'summoning' something?"

Gu Yan was silent.Gray eyes stared at the fragments, tapping his fingers on the table: Yes.Not just a summons.They are talking.Not with sounds, but with thoughts.

He raised his head and looked at Su Tang: They said 'come'.

Su Tang clenched the tea cup.

Speaking of fragments.Not come to me, come to me.The fragments are conscious - no, the energy vortex in the fragments has a core, and the core is summoning the fragments to gather and the source of energy.

Xiaotang, what is the core of the fragment?

The energy vortex in the fragments has one source - the mother body.The matrix is ​​the source of all fragments, and the energy fluctuations it generates will affect all fragments.If the mother body is active, all fragments will be activated and fall at the same time.At that time, instead of dozens of pieces, there will be hundreds or even thousands of pieces falling at the same time.Mortal towns can disappear overnight.

Su Tang’s fingers turned white as they pinched the edge of the tea cup.

Hundreds of pieces of debris fell simultaneously.She thought of the child in Qingxi Town who was directly under the debris, and of the three thousand people Lin Wantang saved by blocking the debris with her body.She didn't want that to happen again.

"Xiaotang, can you clear the mother's body in advance?"

Can.But the host needs to find the mother body and use the power of the anchor to suppress its activity.There is currently only one known mother body, located in the deepest part of Tianwaitian.The host needs to go in person.

Su Tang stood up and paced in the living room.The mother body is in the deepest part of the outer world.Where is the deepest point?She has been to Guixu, the Blue Mountains, and the Spring of Life.Those places are not the deepest.The deepest point is further north of the Spring of Life, an unknown area where the roots of her anchor point cannot extend.

Wan Tang may know.Su Tang turned around. The books in Tianji Pavilion were richer than we imagined.

Three

When Su Tang went to find Wan Tang, Wan Tang was sorting out files in the study room of Tianji Pavilion.

Yin Wuxie stood behind her, holding a bowl of ginseng soup in her hand.Wan Tang didn't drink it this time and put it on the table to cool down.Her long dark red hair was spread over her shoulders, and there was a shallow wrinkle between her eyebrows - a result of thinking, not worries.

Wan Tang, I need to check all the records about the 'matrix' in Tianji Pavilion.Su Tang didn't beat around the bush.

Wan Tang put down the file in his hand and looked at Su Tang.There was no surprise in the crimson eyes, only a sense of calm that had finally come: the mother body.My grandma mentioned this word.She said one day you will come and ask.

She took out a wooden box from the drawer.The wooden box was larger than any of the previous ones, half an arm's length and a span wide.The pattern on the lid is not the cloud pattern of Tianji Pavilion, but a pattern that Su Tang has never seen before - a circle of concentric circles with a point in the center, like a bull's-eye and a whirlpool.

This was left to me by Lin Wantang, my grandma.The sealing condition is 'Anchor Point Query Matrix'. When you spoke just now, the seal was automatically released.

Wan Tang pushed the wooden box in front of Su Tang: there were three things in it: a map, a key, and a sentence.

Su Tang opened the wooden box.

A map.It's not paper, it's a piece of jade, very thin, translucent, with frayed edges, as if it's been touched many times.The jade piece is engraved with dense lines.Su Tang lifted the jade piece and looked at it - the lines became three-dimensional under the light, like a relief sculpture.It was a map of Tianwaitian, more detailed than any she had ever seen.Guixu, the Blue Mountains, the Spring of Life, the ice field to the north of the spring, and the ice field to the north - it's all blank.There is a red dot on the edge of the blank space, and next to the red dot are written two small words: Matrix.
Page (1/3)
